'''March 2000 Brandon tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Brandon, Florida on 3 March 2000. It is known from Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d320">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-07-florida-grand-slam-04-march-2000d320/ florida-grand-slam-04-march-2000], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 7 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-07-florida-grand-slam-04-march-2000d320/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Brandon, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
